items.title: 67250_John Collins oral history interview
items.q: I was studying recently with a guitarist... by the name of Vince Macalooso... I decided to take a few lessons

ctx.x: Who -- I was studying recently with a guitarist, a young guitarist, a tremendous classical guitarist [Macaluso] by the name of Vince Macalooso. Now, I tell you now I heard him. I have a daughter who's a nun and who's a very fine guitarist, oh, she's a very fine guitarist, classical, nothing but classics. And she was studying with Vince and she happened to tell me about him, and I went out to hear him and I heard him and so I decided to take a few lessons, you know. And I enjoyed it, you know, so I do this…
She still has time to play ?
